summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Qfin Holdings, Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting the publication of its annual report for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. The filing includes a reconciliation of material differences between U.S. GAAP and IFRS financial statements. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or management change is disclosed. The filing is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a transactional event. No deal terms are present.
